title: Build a reproducible classifier audit

stages.title: Model and shape contract
stages.evidence: Shape diagram, independent forward calculation, parameter count
stages.expected: PASS stage 1: shape, wiring, parameter count, seeded initialization
stages.diagnosis: If shapes differ, inspect the model output and target axes before changing the loss reduction.

stages.title: Objective and derivative evidence
stages.evidence: Independent stable loss, two finite-difference checks, malformed-label diagnosis
stages.expected: PASS stage 2: independent loss, two-seed finite differences, label contract
stages.diagnosis: If the derivative check fails, compare the stable independent loss and finite-difference tolerance. Preserve the same initialized parameters for both checks.

stages.title: Training audit
stages.evidence: Held-out metrics, full replay, evaluation isolation, count-weighted aggregation
stages.expected: PASS stage 3: held-out metrics, unequal-batch aggregation, evaluation isolation, full replay, changed seed
stages.diagnosis: If training fails, inspect the complete loss history and explicit state transition. Keep the failure output and compare held-out evaluation without mutating model state.

rubric: Explain the nonlinearity and parameter shapes
Verify a stable scalar objective independently
Compare a derivative at two initializations
Keep training and held-out arrays separate
Prove evaluation leaves model state unchanged
Diagnose a deliberate failure and report the repair
State the limitations of synthetic held-out evidence
setupNote: Extract the ZIP into a fresh folder. That folder contains requirements-cpu.txt and projects/mlp-classifier. Use the extracted top folder as your working directory; a full course checkout is optional for this project.
